# Parkinson's disease — diagnosis and biomarkers

> 8 concept packs from the research run on diagnosis and biomarkers (clinical criteria, prodromal stage, staging, genetics, alpha-synuclein seed amplification, imaging, epidemiology and rating scales); 107 of the family's 1,155 claims are grouped under this section in llms-facts.txt. Educational research reference, not medical advice.
> Source: research run parkinsons-diagnosis-genetics-and-biomarkers · Generated: 2026-11-27 by llms-deep-optimizer v1.2.1 · Mode: family

## Concept packs

- [Run-level pack: Diagnosis and biomarkers](https://llmsx.org/tree/parkinson-s-disease-diagnosis-and-biomarkers-clinical-criteria-prodromal-stage-staging-genetics-alpha-synuclein-seed-amplification-imaging-epidemiology-and-rating-scales/): Run-level pack covering clinical criteria, prodromal stage, staging, genetics, alpha-synuclein seed amplification, imaging, epidemiology and rating scales
- [Alpha-synuclein seed amplification assay and fluid biomarkers](https://llmsx.org/tree/alpha-synuclein-seed-amplification-assay-and-fluid-biomarkers/): CSF studies show strong diagnostic performance in selected cohorts, with clinically important heterogeneity in sensitivity
- [Clinical rating scales and outcome measures: MDS-UPDRS](https://llmsx.org/tree/clinical-rating-scales-and-outcome-measures-mds-updrs/): MDS-UPDRS measures non-motor and motor daily-life experiences, motor examination findings, and motor complications in Parkinson’s disease
- [Epidemiology and environmental risk factors: paraquat, TCE, air pollution](https://llmsx.org/tree/epidemiology-and-environmental-risk-factors-paraquat-tce-air-pollution/): Paraquat findings include positive case-control results, null workforce mortality evidence and a qualified EPA assessment finding no clear link for labeled uses
- [Genetics of PD: LRRK2, GBA1, SNCA, PRKN, PINK1](https://llmsx.org/tree/genetics-of-pd-lrrk2-gba1-snca-prkn-pink1/): PD genetics spans dominant LRRK2 and SNCA disease, recessive PRKN and PINK1 disease, and variably penetrant GBA1-associated susceptibility
- [Imaging biomarkers: DaTscan, MRI and PET](https://llmsx.org/tree/imaging-biomarkers-datscan-mri-and-pet/): Dopamine-transporter SPECT identifies presynaptic dysfunction but does not reliably separate PD from atypical degenerative parkinsonism
- [PD diagnosis criteria and differential diagnosis](https://llmsx.org/tree/pd-diagnosis-criteria-and-differential-diagnosis/): Published validation against expert diagnosis should be distinguished from pathological confirmation; autopsy series show clinical overlap and limitations of retrospective documentation
- [PD staging: Hoehn-Yahr, Braak and biological SynNeurGe](https://llmsx.org/tree/pd-staging-hoehn-yahr-braak-and-biological-synneurge/): Braak staging describes a proposed sequence of postmortem α-synuclein pathology; exceptions limit its interpretation as a universal course or clinical severity measure
- [Prodromal PD: RBD, hyposmia and risk prediction](https://llmsx.org/tree/prodromal-pd-rbd-hyposmia-and-risk-prediction/): Hyposmia is associated with increased subsequent PD risk yet has limited specificity

## Top sources, live-checked 2026-11-27

- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7300075 (8 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7300075/): Presynaptic dopamine-transporter imaging supports distinguishing essential tremor from neurodegenerative parkinsonism
- [med.upenn.edu/digitalneuropathologylab/assets (7 claims in this run)](https://www.med.upenn.edu/digitalneuropathologylab/assets/user-content/documents/educational-resources/mds-clinical-diagnostic-criteria-for-parkinson's-disease.pdf): MDS red flags have explicit timing and severity: wheelchair-requiring gait progression within five years, severe autonomic failure within five years
- [exonpublications.com/index.php/exon (6 claims in this run)](https://exonpublications.com/index.php/exon/article/view/191/349): Essential tremor commonly produces bilateral postural/action tremor; PD can also have postural/action tremor, so tremor appearance alone is insufficient for diagnosis
- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6391615 (6 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6391615/): A negative baseline prodromal assessment cannot reliably rule out later phenoconversion in iRBD
- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12162886 (5 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12162886/): Biallelic disease-causing variants are associated with Gaucher disease, whereas heterozygous variants can increase PD risk; these are different genetic counseling contexts
- [pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2605160 (5 claims in this run)](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC2605160/): The Braak pathological sequence is not universal across patients or Lewy-body disorders
- [accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/label (5 claims in this run)](https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/label/2022/022454s010lbl.pdf): DaTscan uses iodine-123 ioflupane SPECT to visualize striatal dopamine transporter availability
- [ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK1223 (5 claims in this run)](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK1223/): Pathogenic LRRK2 variants cause autosomal dominant PD with reduced, age-dependent penetrance; inheriting a pathogenic variant does not guarantee disease
